title: The World's Biggest Bell Weighs 200 Tons and Has Never Rung

scenes.text: The biggest bell ever cast has never rung.
The Tsar Bell weighs over two hundred tons.
It was finished in Moscow in 1735.
Then a fire hit the Kremlin in 1737.
Guards threw cold water on the red-hot bell.
It cracked, and a slab weighing over ten tons broke off. The biggest bell in the world is silent.

description:
The biggest bell ever cast has never rung.
The 200-ton Tsar Bell was finished in 1735, then cracked in a 1737 fire when cold water hit the hot bronze. A slab over ten tons broke off.
If you could ring it, would you?
first_comment: Bonus: the bell fell back into its casting pit and stayed there for about a century. Where is the biggest thing you have ever seen?
